description: This file defines the GuestService module, which handles business logic operations for guests, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and removing guest records.

methods.name: list()
methods.description: Returns an empty array representing the list of guests.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a guest by id, returns null.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new guest with provided data, returns the input data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a guest by id with provided data, returns the data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a guest by id, returns true indicating success.
